verdict.rationale: kitty ships a well-documented remote-control API (`kitty @` / `kitten @`) allowing scripts/agents to open windows, send text, read output, and manage layout, and this was independently verified hands-on with a full agent-control loop (list, send-text, get-text, close-window). Missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/machine-readable schema (probe shows 404s for openapi.json/llms.txt), so discovery is documentation-only rather than a structured API spec.
